title: The fish that walks on land 🐟 #shorts
description: The snakehead can breathe air and slither across land for days. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a fish that can crawl out of the water and travel across dry land? It's the snakehead. It has a primitive lung-like organ that lets it breathe air, so it can survive out of water for days. Using its fins and body, it wriggles across mud and grass to reach new ponds, devouring nearly everything it finds along the way. Drop it far from water, and it simply... walks to find more. An air-breathing predator that refuses to be trapped.
captions: A fish that WALKS on land?
The snakehead.

...and crawls across land for days.
It eats nearly everything it finds.

title: The shark with jaws that shoot out 🦈 #shorts
description: The goblin shark launches its jaws forward to snatch prey. #shorts #animals #nature #ocean #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a shark whose entire jaw can shoot out of its face? It's the goblin shark, a pink, living fossil that has barely changed in over a hundred million years. It drifts in the black deep sea with a long, blade-like snout covered in sensors that detect the faint electricity of hidden prey. When one comes near, its jaws suddenly rocket forward on stretchy ligaments, far beyond its mouth, snapping shut on the victim before slingshotting back into place. A nightmare from another age.

The goblin shark.

title: The fish with invisible fangs 🐉 #shorts
description: The dragonfish has teeth so transparent they can't be seen. #shorts #animals #nature #ocean #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a deep-sea predator with teeth you can't even see? It's the dragonfish. Its fangs are made of a material so clear they're completely transparent, letting it sneak up on prey without a telltale glint of teeth in the dark. It also glows, dangling a lure of living light to draw victims close, and can even produce red light that its prey is blind to, like a hunter with night-vision goggles. In the black depths, it sees you... but you never see it.

title: The animal that fears nothing 🦡 #shorts
description: The honey badger shrugs off venom and fights lions. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's an animal so fearless it attacks creatures many times its size? It's the honey badger. It raids beehives and shrugs off hundreds of stings. It hunts venomous snakes, and if bitten by a cobra, it may pass out for hours, then simply wake up and finish its meal. Its loose, rubbery skin lets it twist around and bite back even when caught in a predator's jaws. Lions, leopards, and pythons all learn to leave it alone.

description: The electric ray delivers shocks strong enough to knock down a person. #shorts #animals #nature #ocean #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a flat, gentle-looking fish that carries a built-in taser? It's the electric ray. Hidden in its rounded body are two organs packed with thousands of jelly-filled cells that work like living batteries. When prey swims near, it wraps around it and unleashes a jolt strong enough to stun a fish instantly, or knock down a grown adult who steps on it. Ancient healers even pressed them onto patients as a shock treatment. A calm disc of muscle... that hides lightning.

title: The fly that spreads the sleeping death 🪰 #shorts
description: The tsetse fly transmits a parasite that invades the brain. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a fly whose bite can put you into an endless sleep? It's the tsetse fly. When it bites, it can inject a microscopic parasite into your blood. At first, there's just fever. But over months, the parasite crosses into the brain, scrambling the body's clock, forcing victims to sleep by day and lie awake by night. Left untreated, they slip into a coma from which they never wake. A single bite... that steals your sleep, then your life.
captions: A fly that causes ENDLESS sleep?
The tsetse fly.

...that scrambles your sleep for months.

title: The snail that can eat a house 🐌 #shorts
description: The giant African land snail devours crops, plaster, and even bones. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a snail the size of your hand that will eat the walls of your house? It's the giant African land snail. Growing up to eight inches long, it devours over five hundred kinds of plants, then starts on the plaster and concrete of buildings to feed its massive shell with calcium. It breeds relentlessly, laying hundreds of eggs, and can carry a parasite dangerous to humans. In many places, touching one is illegal, an unstoppable eating machine in slow motion.

title: The hunter that eats its mate 🐾 #shorts
description: The female praying mantis often devours the male, head first. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a predator that sometimes eats its partner during mating? It's the praying mantis. The much larger female may turn on the male and begin devouring him, head first, even as they mate. Strangely, losing his head doesn't stop him, his body continues on its own, and some studies suggest sacrificing himself gives their young a better chance. With lightning reflexes and spiked arms that snap shut in a fraction of a second, the mantis is a perfect ambush killer, even to its own kind.

title: The organism that eats your brain 🦠 #shorts
description: Naegleria fowleri enters through the nose and destroys the brain. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a tiny organism in warm water that can eat your brain? It's called Naegleria fowleri. It lives in warm lakes and rivers, and it's usually harmless to swallow. But if it goes up your nose, everything changes. It travels along the nerve that carries smell, straight into your brain, and begins to feed. It starts with a headache and a lost sense of smell... and within a week, it's almost always fatal. Barely anyone has ever survived it.

title: The maggots that eat you alive 🪰 #shorts
description: Screwworm larvae burrow into and feed on living flesh. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a fly whose young eat you while you're still alive? It's the screwworm. Most maggots only feed on the dead, but this one is different. A fly lays its eggs in the smallest open wound, and when they hatch, the larvae screw themselves down into living flesh, feeding as they burrow deeper. The wound grows instead of healing, drawing more flies to lay more eggs. Left alone, an infestation can kill a full-grown cow... or a person.

script: Did you know there's a worm that can crawl across your eyeball while you watch? It's called Loa loa, the African eye worm. script: Did you know there's a snake so deadly its bite was once called the kiss of death? It's the black mamba. description: A transmissible facial cancer is wiping out the Tasmanian devil. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's an animal dying from a cancer that spreads between individuals like a disease? It's the Tasmanian devil. It has erased most of the population... a cancer that is, itself, alive and spreading.
